Business Protection Coordinator (Security Officer)  (Contract)

Location: Miami, Florida (Onsite)
Duration: 12-Month Contract (Subject to Extension)
Pay Rate: $25 hourly W2 

 We are seeking a Business Protection Coordinator to support corporate security operations  This role will be responsible for helping ensure the safety, security, and resilience of employees, offices, events, and business operations throughout the region. The successful candidate will partner closely with regional stakeholders, security vendors, and cross-functional teams to manage physical security programs, incident response, risk assessments, and office security initiatives.
This is a highly visible role that requires strong organizational skills, sound judgment under pressure, and the ability to work effectively across multiple countries and cultures. The position is based in Miami, Florida and reports to Business Protection leadership supporting both North and Latin American operations.

Former military, veterans, law enforcement, intelligence, and public safety professionals are strongly encouraged to apply. Experience gained through military service, law enforcement, emergency response, intelligence operations, executive protection, investigations, or related security disciplines is highly valued.

Key Responsibilities Security Operations & Risk Management
  • Support the safety and security of employees, offices, and business operations across Latin America.
  • Monitor and oversee the day-to-day performance of contracted security vendors and guarding teams.
  • Respond to and manage security incidents, investigations, and escalations throughout the region.
  • Conduct risk assessments for offices, events, executive travel, and operations in higher-risk locations.
  • Perform office security audits and recommend improvements to security programs and procedures.
  • Support business travelers and visiting staff with security guidance and risk mitigation measures.
Physical Security & Technology
  • Partner with technical security teams to administer and maintain access control systems, badging programs, alarms, and physical security technologies.
  • Support security planning and implementation for new office openings, renovations, and workplace enhancements.
  • Assist with physical security design reviews and recommend best practices for office environments.
Events & Employee Support
  • Lead or coordinate security operations for corporate events, activations, campaigns, and high-profile gatherings under the direction of Business Protection leadership.
  • Coordinate security planning with vendors, event organizers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Deliver security awareness programs and training initiatives that promote a security-conscious culture.
Collaboration & Strategic Support
  • Serve as a trusted security partner to regional leaders and cross-functional teams.
  • Contribute to broader security, employee experience, and business resilience initiatives.
  • Provide weekly situational awareness updates and security reporting.
  • Assist with special projects supporting expanding regional operations and office growth initiatives.
Required Qualifications
  • Fluent in Spanish (written and verbal).
  • Bachelor's degree in Security Management, Risk Management, Political Science, International Relations, Criminal Justice, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in corporate security, physical security operations, intelligence, risk management, crisis management, law enforcement, military service, or related disciplines.
  • Experience conducting security assessments, managing incidents, and implementing risk mitigation strategies.
  • Hands-on experience with access control systems, security technologies, badging programs, and alarm systems.
  • Strong understanding of modern security practices and corporate security operations.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently throughout Latin America.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Portuguese language proficiency or working comprehension.
  • Experience supporting operations across Latin America.
  • Familiarity with security platforms such as C•CURE (CCURE) or similar access control systems.
  • Experience supporting office construction, security design, or workplace security projects.
  • Knowledge of Apple Mac hardware and Google Workspace tools.
  • Background in military, intelligence, executive protection, emergency management, investigations, or law enforcement environments.

Mid-Level Vehicle Systems Technician (Service Excellence Tech Writer)
Seeking a technician to support a vehicle systems program focused on documentation, testing, troubleshooting, and general system support. This role emphasizes electrical systems, wire harnesses, CAD navigation, and system-level software rather than traditional mechanical repair. Candidates with experience in automotive, aerospace, medical devices, robotics, or similar technical fields are encouraged to apply.

Scope:
• Write and maintain service manuals, service SOPs, work instructions, troubleshooting guides, and technical reports.
• Convert engineering requirements and test results into clear, repeatable service procedures.
• Document test results, repairs, defects, system configurations, and corrective actions.
• Test, inspect, troubleshoot, and validate electrical and electromechanical vehicle systems.
• Read and interpret wiring diagrams, schematics, pinouts, and system documentation.
• Navigate and review existing CAD models, assemblies, drawings, and model trees.
• Locate components, dimensions, notes, features, and design information within CAD files.
• Use basic CAD functions such as view controls, section views, measurements, layers, and assembly navigation.
• Use diagnostic, logging, flashing, and network analysis tools to identify and resolve issues.
• Support root-cause analysis and collaborate with engineering, validation, service, and operations teams.
• Maintain organized lab, shop, vehicle, tool, and inventory areas.

Required:
• Automotive experience required.
• Technician experience in automotive, aerospace, medical devices, robotics, or similar technical fields.
• Experience working in a lab or shop environment, including tool and inventory management.
• Comfortable working in a team environment; this is not a solo position.
• Proficiency with hand tools and electrical test equipment, including multimeters, continuity testers, oscilloscopes, and power supplies.
• Experience using diagnostic, logging, flashing, or network analysis tools to troubleshoot hardware and software systems.
• Ability to read and follow schematics, wiring diagrams, manuals, and technical procedures.
• Ability to navigate and interpret existing CAD files; CAD design or modeling experience is not required.
• Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills.

Pluses:
• Experience troubleshooting vehicle or embedded system software.
• Familiarity with communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, or Ethernet.
• Experience with sensors, calibration, or system validation testing.
• Experience with CAD tools such as CATIA, Siemens NX, SolidWorks, Creo, or similar platforms.

Direct Hire
Plano, TX (Hybrid)
 
Overview
We’re partnering with a confidential, enterprise-scale organization to hire a Senior Azure Data Engineer with deep expertise in Azure Databricks to help design, build, and optimize a modern lakehouse data platform. You’ll develop scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, implement Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) patterns, and enable advanced analytics in a high-volume environment. This role collaborates closely with data architects, data scientists, business stakeholders, and cloud/infrastructure teams to deliver secure, reliable, high-performance data solutions.
What You’ll Do
  • Design and build scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Databricks (PySpark, Spark SQL).
  • Develop ingestion workflows from multiple source systems (e.g., Event Hub, APIs, Azure SQL, Blob Storage) into Bronze/Silver/Gold layers.
  • Implement best practices for Delta Lake and Unity Catalog (schema evolution, versioning, governance).
  • Optimize pipeline performance and cost through partitioning, caching, clustering, and Spark tuning.
  • Integrate Databricks with ADLS Gen2, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Synapse, Event Hub, Key Vault, and Azure DevOps.
  • Implement secure access controls using managed identities, RBAC, and data protection practices (e.g., masking).
  • Partner with analytics and business teams to deliver trusted datasets, metrics, and KPIs.
  • Provide technical leadership through mentoring, code reviews, and architectural guidance.
  • Work with enterprise architecture and security teams to align with data privacy/security policies.
  • Implement data quality checks, alerting, and lineage tracking using tools such as Great Expectations, Unity Catalog, and data observability platforms.
  • Build monitoring dashboards, alerts, and recovery mechanisms for critical pipelines.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of data engineering experience, including 3+ years with Azure Databricks / Apache Spark (PySpark).
  • Strong experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks notebooks, and SQL-based warehousing patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with ADLS Gen2, Event Hub, ADF, Key Vault, Synapse.
  • Strong coding skills in Python and SQL; familiarity with Scala is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of data modeling (OLTP/OLAP), star/snowflake schemas, and performance tuning.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD for Databricks using Databricks CLI, Terraform, and/or Azure DevOps.
  • Databricks certification (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional).
  • Streaming/real-time pipelines (Structured Streaming, Event Hub, Kafka).
  • ML platform exposure (e.g., MLflow or supporting ML pipelines).
  • Reporting/consumption layer experience (e.g., Power BI, Purview, Microsoft Fabric).
  • Knowledge of governance/compliance standards (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2).

Gloucester, MA

Working in environments with moderate to high noise levels

Experience in manufacturing, assembly, or production environments
Strong ability to follow technical instructions and schematics
Hands-on skills with electro-mechanical assemblies and tools
Comfort working in structured, process-driven environments
Interest in or experience within semiconductor or high-tech manufacturing (highly valued)

Yoh is hiring an Associate Scientist, Analytics – Product Development for our pharmaceutical client in Corona, CA. In this role, you will support Product Development and R&D programs focused on the development and approval of generic drug products for U.S. and international markets. The Associate Scientist will perform routine analytical testing, assist with method development and validation activities, maintain laboratory documentation, and support laboratory equipment and Quality Systems under the guidance of senior scientists. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career scientist to develop hands-on pharmaceutical R&D experience with analytical techniques and instrumentation including HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FTIR, and Karl Fischer.

Industry: Pharmaceutical / Product Development
Location: Corona, CA
Compensation: $50k - $60K
Type: Direct Hire

Job Functions
  • Perform routine analytical testing under the direction and supervision of senior scientific personnel.
  • Test raw materials, in-process samples, finished products, and stability samples using established compendial and non-compendial methods.
  • Assist with analytical method development, evaluation, validation, verification, and method transfer activities.
  • Perform analytical techniques including wet chemistry, spectrometry, chromatography, and physical testing.
  • Operate laboratory instrumentation including HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, balances, and other analytical equipment following established procedures.
  • Prepare samples, standards, reagents, and solutions required for analytical testing.
  • Accurately document laboratory testing in accordance with Good Documentation Practices (GDP), company procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Record, analyze, and communicate analytical results to senior scientists and management.
  • Assist with the preparation and execution of study plans, protocols, and reports.
  • Support preparation of technical documentation, including SOPs, analytical methods, validation documentation, and method transfer documentation.
  • Maintain laboratory notebooks, instrument logbooks, and other required records to ensure accuracy, completeness, and data integrity.
  • Assist with preventive maintenance, calibration, qualification, and routine monitoring of laboratory equipment and analytical instruments.
  • Support laboratory Quality Systems, including sample, standard, and reagent management.
  • Assist with monitoring stability chambers and controlled-environment storage equipment.
  • Prepare sample and standard reconciliation documentation and other laboratory reports as required.
  • Support QC data management activities, including data entry, data review, and control charting.
  • Collaborate with Product Development and other cross-functional team members to support project timelines and analytical testing requirements.
  • Provide timely analytical support for R&D activities associated with the development of generic pharmaceutical products for U.S. and international markets.
  • Follow established laboratory procedures, safety requirements, Quality Systems, and compliance programs.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory environment, including proper cleaning and storage of laboratory equipment and glassware.
  • Perform additional laboratory responsibilities as assigned by management.
Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry, Biology, or another related scientific discipline required.
  • Entry level to two (2) years of laboratory experience; pharmaceutical, academic, internship, or related analytical laboratory experience preferred.
  • Basic understanding of analytical chemistry principles and laboratory techniques.
  • Academic or professional hands-on experience with analytical instrumentation such as HPLC, GC, UV-Vis, FTIR, Karl Fischer, or similar laboratory equipment preferred.
  • Familiarity with wet chemistry, chromatography, spectrometry, and physical testing techniques.
  • Exposure to analytical method development, validation, verification, or method transfer is preferred but not required.
  • Basic understanding of Good Documentation Practices (GDP) and laboratory documentation requirements preferred.
  • Pharmaceutical R&D, GMP, GLP, or other regulated laboratory experience is a plus.
  • Ability to accurately follow written analytical methods, SOPs, protocols, and laboratory procedures.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate data collection and documentation.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple laboratory assignments.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively under the guidance of senior scientific personnel and collaborate within a cross-functional team.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and similar software applications.
  • Motivated to learn new analytical techniques, instrumentation, and pharmaceutical development processes.
Physical Job Requirements
  • Pharmaceutical R&D laboratory and office environment.
  • Regularly required to perform hands-on laboratory testing and operate analytical instrumentation and equipment.
  • Regular handling of laboratory glassware, chemicals, samples, standards, and reagents in accordance with established safety procedures.
  • Regular use of computers and related systems for data entry, analysis, documentation, and communication.
  • Ability to stand or sit for extended periods while performing laboratory activities.
  • Must be able to maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory workspace.
